prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage monument line plate. Image 1 is a documentary photograph of the ACTUAL extant building; use it for architecture and geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project's black ink line style sample, never a building-shape reference. Yakushi-ji East Pagoda, Nara, from 730 CE. It is a THREE-storey pagoda with an extra mokoshi skirt roof at each storey, giving SIX visible eave lines; preserve this distinction, the dark timber, white wall zones and finial. Do not conflate with the newer West Pagoda. Tall portrait composition. Omit people, trees, sky, signs and surrounding scenery. Fine neutral BLACK architectural contours, sparse internal detail, no large shaded masses. Keep the complete subject centered with generous margin. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas inside and outside openings. No shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, gray wash, crosshatching, checkerboard, transparency, text, labels, frame or watermark.
